Flutter is an open-source UI framework created by Google for building natively compiled applications across mobile, web, and desktop from a single codebase.

It utilizes the Dart programming language along with a rich library of customizable widgets to deliver fast performance and visually cohesive designs. Furthermore, features like hot reload dramatically accelerate the development process by letting programmers see real-time updates without restarting their apps.
